svg.title: Recording a chat message
svg.desc: 1. The user writes "makan siang 35rb pakai gopay" to their agent in WhatsApp or Telegram. 2. The agent calls quick_record with the sentence and a unique client_ref. 3. BYM finds the token by its hash, then checks scope, the per-token rate limit, the owner's entitlement and the user's consent. 4. In one database transaction with the space context set, the parser reads amount, category, wallet and date and the ledger rows are written. 5. The idempotency record and the agent action are saved in the same transaction. 6. The agent receives an Indonesian summary, the new safe-to-spend figure, an action_id and a link to the entry in the app.
